nl.title: Wachtwoord van e-mailadres wijzigen
nl.excerpt: Wijzig het wachtwoord van een mailbox via E-mail Accounts → Change Password.
nl.bodyHtml:
Mailboxwachtwoorden wijzig je per account onder E-mail Accounts — los van het DirectAdmin-panelwachtwoord.

Voorbereiding

  • Welke mailbox
  • Nieuwe sterke wachtwoord

Stappen

  1. E-mail Accounts
  2. Selecteer de mailbox → Change Password / potlood
  3. Stel nieuw wachtwoord in
  4. Werk telefoon/Outlook/webmail bij
  5. Test versturen en ontvangen

Controleren

  • Oude wachtwoord faalt
  • Nieuw wachtwoord werkt in webmail

Tip: Bij compromise: ook app-wachtwoorden/forwarders controleren.

Let op: Verwar dit niet met Account Manager → Password.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: create-mailbox; cant-login.

en.title: Change email address password
en.excerpt: Change email address password: steps in DirectAdmin for email, address, password.
en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers Change email address password. You work in DirectAdmin, focusing on email, address, password — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to DirectAdmin
  • Focus of this article: email, address, password
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Open DirectAdmin and look specifically for settings around email, address, password.
  2. Select the correct domain/user account in DirectAdmin.
  3. Open the module that fits email (Email, DNS, File Manager, SSL, Cron Jobs, MySQL or Installatron).
  4. Note the current status, then apply only what “Change email address password” requires around address.
  5. Save and test outside DirectAdmin (browser, webmail, DNS lookup or cron log).
  6. Rotate credentials tied to email, address, password if abuse was possible.
  7. Schedule monitoring or a follow-up check.

Verify

  • Result for email, address, password matches “Change email address password”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside email address password
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get email, address, password right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if email, address, password touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: DirectAdmin, backups, tickets.
